一扇草書屏風被當作苫布，推出城去。: A cursive-script screen, used as a tarp, carted out of town.
一艘大船險些撞上虹橋，滿橋的人都在喊。: A big boat nearly hits the Rainbow Bridge; the whole bridge shouts.
兩個腳夫趕著毛驢，馱著木炭往城裏去。: Two drovers drive donkeys loaded with charcoal toward town.
出城的車上蓋著一扇草書屏風，推車的直說可惜。: A cart leaving town is covered with a calligraphy screen; its pusher calls it a pity.
十千腳店掛著新酒旗，酒客進進出出。: The Shiqian tavern flies its new-wine banner; drinkers come and go.
十字街口，軍車急急轉彎，說是去拉節下的酒。: At the crossroads army wagons swing round in a hurry, off to fetch the holiday wine.
城裏也賣紙馬，清明了，上墳用的都有。: Paper horses are sold in town too: everything for the graves at Qingming.
城門內的軍巡鋪裏，弓手守著酒桶，等車來拉。: In the fire post inside the gate, archers guard the wine casks, waiting for the cart.
城門口的一場爭執，一路傳到城外。: A row at the city gate, talked of all the way out of town.
城門外閒坐的人說，稅務所裏又吵起來了。: Idlers outside the gate say the tax office is quarrelling again.
城門稅務所裏，稅吏說匹帛稅重，車夫驚得張大了嘴。: At the gate's tax office the clerk names a heavy silk tax; a carter gapes.
城門裏，運糧的也要納稅，說是送去正店釀酒。: Inside the gate the grain carriers pay tax too: the grain is for the wine house's brewing.
士子們低聲說，元祐諸公的字如今藏不得了。: Scholars whisper that the Yuanyou men's calligraphy can no longer be kept.
大船要過虹橋，船工忙著放倒桅桿。: A big boat must pass the Rainbow Bridge; the crew lower the mast.
大船過橋: The Big Boat at the Bridge
孫羊正店樓上，酒客舉杯，說這香醪果然好。: Upstairs at the Sun Yang wine house, drinkers raise cups to the fine brew.
孫羊正店門前，驢車卸下糧袋，正店要釀酒。: At the Sun Yang wine house door a donkey cart unloads grain for brewing.
寺前路口，又有馱炭的驢在歇腳。: At the road by the temple, more charcoal donkeys rest.
從腳店的新酒旗，到軍巡鋪的酒桶，再到藥鋪的招牌。: From the tavern's new-wine banner to the fire post's casks to the doctor's sign.
扛袋的腳夫說，這些糧要運進城裏去。: The sack porters say this grain is going into town.
棕蓋車停在路邊，車夫說城門口查得緊。: A palm-covered cart waits by the road; its carter says the gate checks are strict.
棕蓋車裏的婦人掀簾往外看，許是上墳回來。: A woman lifts the curtain of a palm-covered cart, back from the graves perhaps.
橋上的人朝下喊，有人拋下繩去。: People on the bridge shout down; someone throws a rope.
河邊歇腳的客人說，郊外有馬驚了。: Travellers resting by the river say a horse bolted out in the fields.
泊在岸邊的船家說，方才虹橋底下好險。: A moored boatman says it was a close call under the Rainbow Bridge.
清明時節，城裏城外都是上墳的人。: At Qingming, town and country are full of people visiting graves.
王家紙馬鋪前，有人來買上墳的紙錢。: At the Wang paper-goods shop, people buy paper money for the graves.
畫卷開頭的炭驢，馱的是城裏酒店灶下的炭。: The charcoal donkeys at the scroll's start carry fuel for the town's tavern stoves.
碼頭上卸糧，船主坐在麻袋上，記賬的一袋袋點數。: Grain is unloaded at the wharf; the owner sits on his sacks while the tally man counts.
腳店門前的串車上，也蓋著一扇字屏。: The cart at the tavern door carries a calligraphy screen too.
船上卸下的糧袋，一路運到城裏的正店。: Grain sacks from the boats, carried all the way to the town's wine house.
虹橋下，馱著大糧袋的驢往城裏走。: Below the Rainbow Bridge, donkeys with big grain sacks head for town.
虹橋邊的小酒館，灶下燒的正是城外運來的炭。: The little tavern by the bridge burns charcoal brought from the country.
賣卦攤上，一個客商問：城門稅重，買賣還做得成麼？: At the fortune-teller's a trader asks: with the gate tax so heavy, will my deal work?
趙太丞家的招牌寫著治酒所傷，可見喝酒成風。: Doctor Zhao's sign offers a cure for drink: drinking was the fashion.
路邊有人急喚孩子，躲開那匹驚馬。: By the road someone calls a child out of the bolting horse's way.
轎頂插著楊柳雜花，一家人上墳回城。: Willow and flowers on the sedan roof: a family back from the graves.
郊外一匹馬驚了，幾個人跟在後面追。: Out in the fields a horse has bolted; men run after it.
郊外一匹馬驚了，消息傳到了河邊。: A horse bolted in the fields, and the news reached the river.
